description: This file is a CMake module script used to find and configure the GStreamer video library (gstreamer-video-1.0) for a build system. It defines variables indicating whether the library was found, sets up external library references, and creates imported target definitions for use in the build process.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Find and load the configuration for a specified package.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Use pkg-config to check for the specified modules.

methods.name: FIND_PACKAGE_HANDLE_STANDARD_ARGS
methods.description: Macro to handle success/failure of package finding.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Find a library and store its path.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Create a new library target, optionally imported.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Set properties for target build configuration.
